``` Welcome to the PMG GLP Program! This guide is designed to help you transition into life in Dallas. WILL NEED TO UPDATE MORE LATER USING IN-DEPTH DETAILS # Choosing Your Neighborhood ## Inner Loop The PMG office sits in Uptown, so the closer you live to McKinney Avenue, the shorter your commute — and usually the higher your rent. ## Inner-Loop Options | Neighborhood | Vibe and what's nearby | Average 1BR rent* | |---|---|---| | [Uptown](https://www.google.com/search?q=uptown+dallas){target="_blank"} | Walkable to the office, McKinney Avenue trolley, Katy Trail, and nightlife. | $2,400–$2,800+ | | [Knox–Henderson](https://www.google.com/search?q=knox+henderson+dallas){target="_blank"} | Trendy shopping and dining, about 10 minutes from the office. | ~$1,800 | | [Oak Lawn](https://www.google.com/search?q=oak+lawn+dallas){target="_blank"} | Residential feel with access to Katy Trail and Turtle Creek. | ~$1,900–$2,200 | | [Deep Ellum](https://www.google.com/search?q=deep+ellum+dallas){target="_blank"} | Arts, murals, restaurants, and live music east of Downtown. | ~$1,950 | | [Bishop Arts](https://www.google.com/search?q=bishop+arts+dallas){target="_blank"} | Walkable shops, restaurants, and patios in a historic district. | ~$1,300–$1,500 | | [Lower Greenville](https://www.google.com/search?q=lower+greenville+dallas){target="_blank"} | Bars, restaurants, and a young-professional crowd near Lakewood and SMU. | ~$1,700 | ## Suburban Options | Area | Vibe and what's nearby | Average 1BR rent* | Commute to Uptown | |---|---|---|---| | [Richardson](https://www.google.com/search?q=richardson+tx){target="_blank"} | Quiet, good value, and close to UT Dallas and the Telecom Corridor. | ~$1,300–$1,400 | 25–30 min via US-75 | | [Addison](https://www.google.com/search?q=addison+tx){target="_blank"} | Large restaurant and bar scene along Belt Line Road. | ~$1,450–$1,550 | 20–25 min via DNT | | [Plano](https://www.google.com/search?q=plano+tx){target="_blank"} | Family-friendly, with major corporate offices and Legacy West. | ~$1,350–$1,450 | 30–35 min via DNT or US-75 | | [Frisco](https://www.google.com/search?q=frisco+tx){target="_blank"} | Newer development, sports venues, restaurants, and retail. | ~$1,300–$1,400 | 35–45 min via DNT | | [Las Colinas](https://www.google.com/search?q=las+colinas+irving){target="_blank"} | Canals, trails, corporate campuses, and quick access to DFW Airport. | ~$1,550–$1,750 | 20–25 min via I-35E | *Rough averages as of mid-2026. Rents vary by season, building, and current availability.* ::: {.callout-tip} ### Rule of Thumb The closer you live to Uptown and McKinney Avenue, the higher the rent but the easier the commute. Richardson, Plano, and Frisco can cost less but require a daily highway commute. ::: # Finding an Apartment ## Where to Search - [Apartments.com](https://www.apartments.com/){target="_blank"} - [Zillow](https://www.zillow.com/dallas-tx/apartments/){target="_blank"} - [Apartment List](https://www.google.com/aclk?sa=L&pf=1&ai=DChsSEwjbv82N24mWAxUqcX8AHTn4DAYYACICCAEQCxoCb2E&co=1&ase=2&gclid=CjwKCAjwvsvTBhBaEiwAmf-3ni68j8czqhSJmE6v6nDrDeRhCroDx8NPZ7K_60o6uWwNEodqz79K0BoC7JQQAvD_BwE&cid=CAASWeRoV_hDPOCkIySofGIxFzOsxFjcNl_5mtzLutcCsUSDTl_mNWmhoaOfHUtQQR578INKsFPDzqjwQ7TPWa1JvbjSbuXFJWY1ErvzILpZy-IAphDmMnLvPhDp&cce=2&category=acrcp_v1_32&sig=AOD64_1IRtqj5sq0zT7pWGU556Dbr4OPsQ&q&nis=4&adurl=https://www.apartmentlist.com/quiz?state%3Dtx%26city%3Ddallas%26verified%3Dtrue%26verified%3Dtrue%26campaign%3Dgoogle_8384380512%26utm_medium%3Dcpc%26utm_source%3Dgoogle%26utm_campaign%3Ds-c-e-8384380512-180137759657-763269643183-kwd-28109180%26utm_content%3Daimax_%7Bexperimentid%7D%26gad_source%3D1%26gad_campaignid%3D8384380512%26gbraid%3D0AAAAADrCDNyJNkRxqpGzIMcsFaKamrzr6%26gclid%3DCjwKCAjwvsvTBhBaEiwAmf-3ni68j8czqhSJmE6v6nDrDeRhCroDx8NPZ7K_60o6uWwNEodqz79K0BoC7JQQAvD_BwE&ved=2ahUKEwjfjcaN24mWAxXsmmoFHY9CBq4Q0Qx6BAgWEAE){target="_blank"} ::: {.callout-important} Always ask about move-in specials before signing. ::: ## Apartment Fees | Fee | Typical Cost | |-----|--------------| | Application | $50–75 | | Parking | $100–200 | | Valet Trash | $20 | # Transportation ## Major Highways ### US-75 **Pros** -
